body.statement: For fixed \(q\), when \(\widehat\psi\) and \(\widehat\Sigma_C\) use the corrected coherent projector in Theorem 8, \(\sqrt n(C\widehat\psi-C\psi)\rightsquigarrow N(0,\Sigma_C)\), \(\widehat\Sigma_C\to_P\Sigma_C\), and the Gaussian maximum-\(t\) critical value computed from the correlation matrix of \(\widehat\Sigma_C\) gives simultaneous coverage converging to \(1-\alpha\) for all \(q\) coordinates of \(\theta=C\psi\).
body.justification: The application compares several adjacent smoking levels, so scalar pointwise intervals do not answer the scientific question.
body.gap: The closest hidden-treatment theory is centered on a binary contrast and does not provide fixed-dimensional joint maximum-\(t\) inference for ordered multilevel effects.
body.consumer: It supports one familywise-valid assessment of all declared six-bin maternal-smoking contrasts.
body.proof_tex:
Multiplying the expansion in Theorem 8 by the fixed matrix \(C\) gives
\[
\sqrt n(C\widehat\psi-C\psi)
=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^nC\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_P(1)
\rightsquigarrow N(0,CV_{\mathrm{eff}}C^{\mathsf T}). \tag{44}
\]
Consistency of \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}\) and continuity of matrix multiplication give \(\widehat\Sigma_C\to_P\Sigma_C\).  Positive definiteness makes every diagonal variance positive and makes standardization continuous in a neighborhood of \(\Sigma_C\).

Let \(R_C\) and \(\widehat R_C\) be the correlation matrices obtained from \(\Sigma_C\) and \(\widehat\Sigma_C\).  Then \(\widehat R_C\to_PR_C\).  For fixed \(q\), the distribution of \(\max_{r\leq q}|Z_r|\), \(Z\sim N(0,R_C)\), is continuous because every coordinate has a continuous marginal and the boundary of a rectangle has Gaussian probability zero.  Therefore its \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile evaluated at \(\widehat R_C\) converges to the true quantile.  Applying this fact to (44) and the consistent coordinate standard errors proves simultaneous coverage tending to \(1-\alpha\).  The centering condition \(C\mathbf 1_K=0\) makes all rows treatment contrasts, while full row rank and positive information exclude redundant or zero-variance reported coordinates.
